$comment: Glossary terms for the publish, test, monitor, secure, govern, and billing training briefs. Each entry is defined once; terms.json has the shared ones.

user-authentication.plain: proving who a person is, usually by signing in, before an agent shares private information

single-sign-on.plain: letting a person who is already signed in to a page or app skip a second sign-in to the agent

content-moderation.plain: filters that check an agent's answers for harmful content and can block them

agent-identity.plain: a Microsoft Entra account that lets an agent prove who it is to channels and services

test-set.plain: a saved group of test questions or conversations that you can run again and again

agent-session.plain: one stretch of conversation between a person and an agent, as counted in reports

conversation-transcript.plain: the saved record of what a person and an agent said in a conversation

pay-as-you-go.plain: paying at the end of each month for what an agent actually used, through an Azure subscription

usage-based-billing.plain: paying for how much you use something, instead of paying one fixed price per user

foundry-guardrail.plain: a set of safety controls that watch what goes into and comes out of a model or an agent

agent-trace.plain: a record, in order, of what an agent did to answer one request

oversharing.plain: content that more people can reach than should be able to

agent-registry.plain: a list of the agents in an organization, with their owners and status

sharepoint-advanced-management.plain: SharePoint tools that help manage content sprawl, content lifecycle, and oversharing

agent-365.plain: Microsoft's central place to observe, govern, and secure agents across an organization

agent-builder.plain: a Microsoft 365 Copilot tool for building agents with instructions and chosen knowledge sources
